title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on Dhani Loans and Services Limited
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has, by an order dated July 15, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of ₹2.70 lakh (Rupees Two Lakh Seventy Thousand only) on Dhani Loans and Services Limited (the company) for non-compliance with certain directions issued by RBI on ‘Asset Classification’.
